description: This file is a header defining utility functions and constants for WAN manager testing, including function declarations for setup, teardown, device handling, JSON reading, and WAN mode management.

methods.name: test_wan_manager_setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment for WAN manager tests.

methods.name: test_wan_manager_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up after WAN manager tests.

methods.name: remove_device_prefix
methods.description: Removes device prefix from input string.

methods.name: test_get_dm
methods.description: Retrieves the test device manager object.

methods.name: test_get_parser
methods.description: Retrieves the parser used in testing.

methods.name: read_json_from_file
methods.description: Reads JSON data from specified file.

methods.name: enable_wan_mode
methods.description: Enables specified WAN mode, checking expected status.

methods.name: disable_wan_mode
methods.description: Disables specified WAN mode, checking expected status.

methods.name: set_wan_mode
methods.description: Sets WAN mode with expected status.

methods.name: assert_active_wan_mode
methods.description: Asserts that the active WAN mode matches expected values.
